verdict.rationale: IRS first-party docs describe several sanctioned third-party rails. A third-party designee may apply for an EIN with signed authorization from the responsible party (irs-supp-13). Authorized IRS e-file Providers transmit returns through MeF after a credentialed enrollment that takes up to 45 days and may include fingerprinting (irs-supp-5, irs-supp-6, irs-supp-7). IRIS A2A lets transmitters holding a Transmitter Control Code file information returns (irs-supp-8). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these rails work as documented, and no evidenced delegation rail into the ID.me-gated Online Account and signed mobile-friendly forms such as the online 83(b), which end at the taxpayer personally (irs-supp-12).
